name: Holier Than Thou: Emil's Story
source:
Three years ago, Emil’s parents and little sister were killed in a terrorist attack while attending the Norse V Summer Camp. Although the police arrested several suspects and closed the case, Emil still seriously presumes that the famous actor Andreas Hisglif Hansen, who had also attended the summer camp, was somehow involved in the terrorist attack.

Not long before our story starts, Emil finally joined MVA, the company that Andreas is working at, to find the truth behind his family’s death.
